\begin{example} \end{example}[differentiable but not an immersion] 1. ch0:3.3

$\alpha :\mathbb {R}\to \mathbb {R}^2$, $\alpha (t)=(t^3,t^2)$, is differentiable but not an immersion: the immersion condition is $\alpha '(t)\neq 0$, which fails at $t=0$ (Fig. 6). \end{example}
